facts.excerpt: We also provide technical assistance to help businesses gain MWBE certification and are backing this work with a $25 million MWBE lending program.

We have already launched MWBE capacity-building efforts, including two contracting sessions at Citi Field, a $25 million lending program to expand capital access, and robust prequalification processes.
Hard Rock Metropolitan Park has committed $25 million to developing and implementing a small business lending program.
This program will assist small businesses in receiving loans and reducing lender risk, ultimately maximizing the potential for success for small businesses in the surrounding communities.
